posts.author: gregisenberg
posts.text:
Strange feeling: finding out an album you love was made with AI music models (Suno, Udio, Lyria) and with no people playing instruments.

I play music. I listened for months and had no idea.

The top 1% of AI music is getting scary good. https://t.co/abc3g3nyl8
posts.text_zh:
奇怪的感觉：发现自己喜欢的一张专辑是用 AI 音乐模型（Suno、Udio、Lyria）做的，没有真人演奏乐器。

我自己也玩音乐。听了好几个月完全没听出来。

AI 音乐顶尖的那 1% 已经好到吓人了。https://t.co/abc3g3nyl8
